private_evidence.summary: Privately reviewed focus and priority-region compromise
Guarded USB migration, retained backup and separate recorder fix
Approved private solar/pause/storage supervision and historical bounded sessions
Private sampled packet collector: 41 local regression tests
Private readiness/worker/fingerprint monitor: 30 local regression tests
Private provenance/keeper/observation finalizer: 111 local regression tests
Approved bounded selected-image visual review instructions and partial sample review
Private preparation/Telegram integration; no new delivery verified here

requirements.feature: Owner-approved priority focus compromise
requirements.gap: Approval supports one priority region, not sharpness at every distance or published private views.

requirements.feature: Measured full-resolution negotiated camera output
requirements.gap: Live dimensions/format are evidenced; metadata/parser tests do not exercise all real degraded-negotiation cases.

requirements.feature: Arrival fixture includes available pretrigger frame
requirements.gap: No known implementation gap within this bounded requirement; broader field gates remain separate.

requirements.feature: Region-bound triggering and lighting fixture
requirements.gap: Synthetic fixture coverage is not calibrated field recall, lighting robustness, or absence evidence.

requirements.feature: Optional arrival-yield diagnostic benchmark
requirements.gap: Optional 18-of-20 observer-backed study not performed; not a keeper-workflow completion blocker.

requirements.feature: Optional nuisance-rate tuning study
requirements.gap: No evidence passes the proposed five-nuisance-events/hour two-hour reviewed study; this is an optional diagnostic target.

requirements.feature: Measured on-device licensed model feasibility
requirements.gap: Actual local latency/memory and control inference exist; full concurrent capture impact and per-event budget across conditions are not proven.

requirements.feature: Independent species evaluation sample sizes
requirements.gap: No validated species model or independent 100-crop/per-species evaluation set is established.

requirements.feature: Held-out accuracy, abstention and miss reporting
requirements.gap: A few model candidates/controls are not top-1/precision/recall evaluation; no untouched species evaluation report exists.

requirements.feature: Species precision gate with explicit abstention
requirements.gap: Shadow unknown is explicit; a species classifier and 90-percent accepted-label precision evaluation are absent.

requirements.feature: Analysis failures and ambiguous inputs
requirements.gap: Model/bad-image failures are tested; unsupported species, cross-frame species disagreement, and low-quality classification policies are not implemented.

requirements.feature: Post-capture evenly spaced frame detection
requirements.gap: Worker samples evenly spaced completed-event frames rather than quality-ranked best frames. Bird boxes are produced, but crop species classification with contextual margins is not implemented.

requirements.feature: Per-frame list of bird candidate boxes
requirements.gap: Decoder can return multiple boxes and results store detection lists. Tests do not establish end-to-end multiple-bird identity handling; no per-bird species identification records or cross-frame identity association exist.

requirements.feature: Immutable originals and source-relative detection coordinates
requirements.gap: Original bytes, manifest/frame links and original-image box coordinates exist. Persistent contextual classification crops with explicit crop-to-source records are not a complete public feature; private review crops are a separate bounded workflow.

requirements.feature: Raw detector scores with explicit uncertainty
requirements.gap: Raw detector scores are stored and described as uncalibrated. No classifier exists, so separate detector/classifier score storage is not yet exercised.

requirements.feature: Detector provenance and inference receipt
requirements.gap: Analysis records inference UTC, detector revision/hash/preprocess version and score. No top-three species suggestions, common/scientific names, classifier or species label-map version exist.

requirements.feature: Provisional candidate threshold only
requirements.gap: Detector threshold validation is not the species-label acceptance contract. No species score/margin, crop-quality/size or cross-frame agreement gate exists; thresholds lack labeled feeder calibration.

requirements.feature: Sampling without multi-frame confirmation
requirements.gap: Multiple sampled frames are independent proposals, not agreement-based confirmation. No two-usable-frame species agreement or explicit single-frame confirmation policy is implemented.

requirements.feature: Candidate, unknown and failed shadow states
requirements.gap: Shadow states are bird_candidate, unknown and analysis_failed, not the target unknown_bird/no_bird_detected species-state vocabulary. Unknown explicitly means no returned sampled detection, never proof of absence.

requirements.feature: Read-only analysis with ordinary retention
requirements.gap: No known recognition-based suppression/deletion path: analyzer only reads originals and retention is independent of scores. Preservation was fingerprinted on a measured subset; age/quota pressure can expire unpinned raw photos before review, and this is not comprehensive field durability validation.

requirements.feature: No location or seasonal species reranking
requirements.gap: No current reranker or occurrence lookup exists. Any future reranking must document its source and preserve unexpected raw species suggestions; those safeguards are not yet executable tests.

requirements.feature: Separate authoritative manual corrections
requirements.gap: Manual annotation storage, correction interface and reanalysis preservation are absent. Queue idempotence and changed-settings jobs do not prove authoritative-correction preservation.

requirements.feature: 24-hour cumulative daylight workload soak
requirements.gap: Short sessions and component tests do not pass the cumulative daylight soak with required instrumentation.

requirements.feature: Combined application memory budget
requirements.gap: Detector memory was benchmarked; complete concurrent application workload below the proposed 2-GiB budget is not measured.

requirements.feature: Physical unplug/replug within recovery target
requirements.gap: Timeout and reconnect logic/tests are not the physical 60-second unplug/replug acceptance experiment.

requirements.feature: Failure fixtures preserve existing photographs
requirements.gap: Representative disk/recovery/interruption cases pass; not every inference-crash or physical power-loss scenario is established.

requirements.feature: Coordinated reboot and single-owner restart
requirements.gap: Ownership checks exist; no coordinated reboot/startup/rollback evidence passes this full field gate.

requirements.feature: Automated tracked-secret and photograph audit
requirements.gap: One-off publication privacy scans and ignore rules are not an installed comprehensive tracked-secret/photo audit; the traceability checker only validates mappings/references.

requirements.feature: Idle capture lock and bounded review worker
requirements.gap: Private collector/scheduler regressions pass; public checkout cannot reproduce private helpers and all hardware interruption cases remain open.

requirements.feature: Sampled candidate/control review and honest counts
requirements.gap: Packet sampling is exercised; complete visual compliance for every scheduled review is not verified by collector tests.

requirements.feature: Packet-bound verified keeper copying and safe validation
requirements.gap: 111 private finalizer tests cover validation/copy safety; no new live-archive end-to-end finalization was executed by this task.

requirements.feature: Idempotent photo observations and uncertainty
requirements.gap: Idempotent logging is privately tested; every natural-language digest error/uncertainty statement is not covered by those tests.

requirements.feature: Prepared versus delivered digest and deduplication
requirements.gap: Preparation/fingerprint behavior is privately tested; provider acceptance and ambiguous-delivery recovery are not end-to-end verified here.

requirements.feature: Perch-position stationary calibration target
requirements.gap: Private focus samples/framing were exercised, but the supplied evidence does not establish a detailed stationary target at every expected perch position. No integrated calibration tooling or public test applies.

requirements.feature: Autofocus and supported manual focus sweep
requirements.gap: Private reversible focus comparison exists; a complete autofocus baseline plus sweep across discovered supported ranges is not demonstrated by public evidence. Package focus changes are unsupported.

requirements.feature: Texture sharpness glare and exposure comparison
requirements.gap: Private sample inspection does not establish feather-sized detail, exposure and reflection comparison at both spots. Priority-feeder approval is not a full two-distance optical acceptance result.

requirements.feature: Private selected focus mode and priority ROI
requirements.gap: Priority ROI approval and private configuration workflow exist; chosen focus-mode calibration is not applied/stored by an integrated calibration command. Public tests cover rectangle/data-path safeguards, not private review or calibration persistence.

requirements.feature: Optical-distance correction rather than digital fix
requirements.gap: No software/digital-zoom optical cure is claimed. Evidence does not establish near-perch repositioning and successful repeat calibration if needed; physical optical improvement remains conditional private work.

requirements.feature: User sample approval before unattended capture
requirements.gap: Private framing/priority-region approval exists and approved schedules are separate. No public approval interlock or complete sample-review chronology establishing every calibration clause before unattended operation is available; enabled jobs do not prove live success.

requirements.feature: 1080p MJPEG 15 fps requested defaults
requirements.gap: Requested defaults and short negotiated live smoke exist. Default test asserts width, not height/fps/FFmpeg arguments, and sustained throughput is not measured.

requirements.feature: Persistent unscaled camera stream
requirements.gap: One camera context encloses the run loop and JPEGs are copied without event resolution changes. Replay tests do not assert real FFmpeg process open counts across multiple events; long live persistence remains a reliability gate.

requirements.feature: Stable endpoint preference and capture capability
requirements.gap: Auto discovery prefers by-id video-index0, but does not query V4L2 capture capabilities. Explicit configured paths and video0 fallback can select non-capture endpoints; rejection relies on stream failure, not setup capability validation.

requirements.feature: Negotiated metadata and explicit degraded mode
requirements.gap: Actual decoded dimensions and optional negotiated fps/format are reported; original bytes are not upscaled. Requested settings are not recorded alongside actual values, missing format/fps is not a complete degraded diagnosis, and degraded comparison omits pixel-format mismatch. No direct degraded-mode assertion.

requirements.feature: Discoverable focus and exposure controls
requirements.gap: Public focus changes are explicitly rejected and metadata says focus_controls_applied=false. No exposure configuration, range discovery or control application exists; regression verifies honest refusal, not the feature. Private experiments are not integrated configuration support.

requirements.feature: Warmup, read failure and capped reconnect
requirements.gap: Warmup discard, no-frame timeout and exponential retry capped at 30 seconds exist. Repeated stale-but-decodable frames are not detected; tests do not assert warmup counts/backoff cap or physical unplug/replug recovery.

requirements.feature: Graceful release and ownership-safe test procedure
requirements.gap: Documentation says stop the capture process before doctor/snapshot and explains Ctrl-C/SIGTERM. Tests cover lock release and writer drain, not real Camera.__exit__ terminate/kill paths or coordination with every private service/scheduler; physical shutdown acceptance remains pending.

requirements.feature: Available foreground CLI and private automation boundary
requirements.gap: Six commands exist and package does not install private jobs; solar cutoff is not in run. Help/analysis tests do not prove end-to-end behavior for every command or operator adherence to approved daylight. Enabled schedules cannot establish liveness.

requirements.feature: Doctor camera diagnostics versus full system checks
requirements.gap: Doctor opens the camera, reads negotiated metadata and loads config. It does not enumerate control ranges, check model/runtime compatibility, or validate storage writability/free-space state. Helper tests and historical live invocation do not verify the full doctor contract.

requirements.feature: Exclusive private snapshot capture
requirements.gap: Snapshot saves one new private JPEG using configured stream settings and ownership lock, with documented stop-first procedure. Chosen focus/exposure controls are unsupported; tests cover safety helpers rather than complete snapshot execution, overwrite race or real service-stop coordination.

requirements.feature: Integrated sample and ROI calibration command
requirements.gap: No calibrate subcommand exists. Private samples/annotated priority-ROI approval are a separate setup workflow, not an implemented or tested public command.

requirements.feature: Foreground motion capture without internal model queue
requirements.gap: Foreground capture exists and internal queued inference is explicitly future. Replay and no-frame/config tests do not exercise a successful real-camera run through the CLI subprocess; historical hardware smoke is short and does not pass soak/reboot gates.

requirements.feature: Stored status snapshot versus complete health contract
requirements.gap: Status prints health.json or not_started. Health has counters/state/capture metadata, but lacks dedicated last-frame/event timestamps, writer queue depth, complete storage state and inference health; no stale-report age/liveness check. Integration asserts saved health, not status command coverage.

requirements.feature: Local event listing versus date/species/state filters
requirements.gap: Events supports --limit and capture-time sorting only. Date, species and analysis-state filters are absent; species classification is also future. Existing tests verify listing safety/order, not promised filters.

requirements.feature: Append-only identification correction command
requirements.gap: No correct command or immutable model-result correction API exists in the public package. Private provenance-backed visual confirmation is not a substitute for the promised identification-correction interface.

requirements.feature: Selected-event versioned reanalysis command
requirements.gap: No reanalyze command, selected-event selector or user-selected model-version interface exists. Analyze can create new jobs for changed analysis settings and protects old provenance, but those tests cover only an adjacent capability, not this CLI contract.

requirements.feature: Strict partial TOML schema and calibration-required example
requirements.gap: Only camera/motion/capture/storage groups exist; regions are nested under motion. Detection/classification/logging/location/runtime groups and explicit configuration schema version/migrations are absent. Bounds and safe external data-root checks exist, but writable paths are not fully preflighted before capture. Example has disabled generic ROI placeholders and capture requires no GitHub token.

requirements.feature: External data root and private guarded USB archive
requirements.gap: Example root and Git isolation are public; deployed USB identity guards and separate backup are private evidence, not reproducible from checkout. Core run does not verify the deployed volume, and stale health/default paths cannot establish the active archive.

requirements.feature: UUID event IDs, UTC receipts and monotonic intervals
requirements.gap: UUID IDs, UTC receipts and monotonic lifecycle exist; public original filenames are integer frame IDs, not explicitly UTC-bearing names. Display timezone/local-day filtering belong to private review, while capture partitions remain UTC. Local-date partitioning and full end-to-end timezone/collision tests are absent.

requirements.feature: Capture manifest plus separate shadow result schema
requirements.gap: Capture identity/regions/settings/receipt paths and shadow errors/detections/provenance are present in separate records. Unified quality metrics/ranking, species suggestions and authoritative corrections remain absent; do not infer a complete target schema or index.

requirements.feature: Atomic journaled writes and incomplete-event recovery
requirements.gap: No known gap in the exercised process-interruption/atomic-recovery contract. Real subprocess termination around JPEG/manifest renames is tested; physical power-loss/filesystem durability is not validated and must not be inferred.

requirements.feature: Readable JSON manifests independent of shadow SQLite
requirements.gap: No known gap in standalone manifest readability and optional queue separation. A full event/species index plus migration/backup framework remains future work; the current queue schema version check is not such a framework.

requirements.feature: Configurable age/quota/reserve retention
requirements.gap: Public defaults are 14 days / 5 GiB / 2-GiB reserve; private deployed raw policy is 14 days / 40 GiB / 2-GiB reserve. No guaranteed review availability or long-duration reserve-pressure validation; deployed recorder storage-pressure fix remains outside public source.

requirements.feature: Hash-verified keeper archive outside raw retention
requirements.gap: Reported private finalizer copies source-hash-verified originals outside raw retention, permits at most five keepers, and automatic review inspects/selects at most three with zero allowed. Private tests/reports are not executable from checkout; no public keeper implementation or calibrated keeper-quality/yield validation exists.

requirements.feature: Packet-bound review receipt and delivery deduplication
requirements.gap: Private review records fingerprints, explicit source decisions, scope/errors and provenance. A prepared receipt is not delivery proof; uncertain Telegram outcomes require reconciliation rather than blind replay. Public checkout cannot reproduce private delivery or prove exactly-once delivery across all failure windows.

requirements.feature: Managed-only pruning, pins and total raw-root accounting
requirements.gap: Pins/active events and unknown/symlink content are protected; _usage counts nonsymlink files under raw root including metadata/temporaries. External analysis SQLite has its own budget, not a unified crop/index-overhead storage monitor; no public pin/unpin CLI and deployed storage-pressure fix is not reconciled.

requirements.feature: Reserve rejection and storage-full reporting
requirements.gap: EventStore rejects writes with storage_full and preserves pins; writer counts failures. Public run_capture does not merge EventStore.health storage_full into periodic health or implement the separately deployed pressure-suspension fix. Continued healthy reporting under every full-disk condition is not proved.

requirements.feature: Private artifact Git exclusions and bounded-log policy
requirements.gap: Git exclusions and private output guards exist, but ignores are not a comprehensive secret/photo scanner and can be bypassed by forced tracking. No public bounded rotating-log subsystem or rotation regression tests; private operational log policy is not public implementation proof.

requirements.feature: Implicit event lifecycle with reconnect interruption
requirements.gap: Warmup lives in camera/detector, active/idle/cooldown are implicit event fields and reconnect state is runner health. There is no unified explicit WARMUP/IDLE/ACTIVE/COOLDOWN/ERROR state enum/reporting; reconnect interruption and transition coverage are incomplete.

requirements.feature: Time/count/byte bounded pre-trigger JPEG buffer
requirements.gap: Default one-second 5 fps prebuffer is bounded by time, count and bytes. Tests exercise shorter configured windows/count and byte pressure, not a complete default one-second capacity boundary. Config permits other sampling rates; sustained field memory bounds are not measured.

requirements.feature: Original-byte bounded bursts and missed-save accounting
requirements.gap: Configurable sampling and identity-based dedup preserve actual receipt timestamps; dropped saves are counted, not filled with duplicates. Private deployment saves 3 fps versus acquisition request 15 fps. No sustained exact-rate/complete missed-sensor-frame accounting is proven; public tests use synthetic/replay timing and private recorder storage fix still needs source reconciliation.

requirements.feature: Single event with union of triggering regions
requirements.gap: Motion from simultaneous/sequential regions shares one event and region union is stored. Presence-trigger input is not implemented, so the complete motion/presence clause is partial; real multi-region field triggering is not established.

requirements.feature: Quiet/max duration and repeated burst defaults
requirements.gap: Defaults implement 5-second quiet, 30-second maximum and at-least-5-second repeat spacing. Existing timing test uses modified quiet/maximum and max_bursts=1; it does not assert repeated-burst spacing or all unmodified defaults. Long live event behavior remains unvalidated.

requirements.feature: Three-second cooldown and renewed events
requirements.gap: Cooldown is implemented with a 3-second default; timing test proves cooldown/new-event behavior with a 1-second override, not exact default timing on deployment hardware.

requirements.feature: Bounded visual keeper review without editing originals
requirements.gap: Private bounded visual workflow and original-preserving finalization exist; public tests establish source safety only, not sharpness/exposure/pose/variety selection quality. Automatic quality ranking is explicitly future; representative keeper-quality field acceptance remains incomplete.

requirements.feature: Maximum bursts with rate-limit observability
requirements.gap: Configured max_bursts bounds repeated saves and is exercised synthetically. Exhausted-burst/rate-limit decisions are silently skipped, not individually logged, and field-rate-limit observability is not established.

requirements.feature: Linked continuous-presence segments not bird counts
requirements.gap: Max-duration restart includes continuation:<previous_event_id> and manifests retain the reason. Test asserts end/start and max_duration, but not the continuation ID or persisted linkage. Physical long-presence testing remains pending; event counts are not individual-bird counts.

requirements.feature: Keeper-focused collection, not a census
requirements.gap: Motion photography and private selection exist; good-photo yield and complete end-to-end recurring delivery are not field-validated.

requirements.feature: Local core with explicit external-service boundaries
requirements.gap: No per-frame cloud inference; external solar/review/delivery and their failure combinations are not fully field-validated.

requirements.feature: Private regional hints and deployment identity
requirements.gap: No implemented species reranker or hard regional filter; privacy is an approved publication rule, not a fully automated repository-audit guarantee.

requirements.feature: Linux USB MJPEG camera target
requirements.gap: No known gap for the initial C920 target: historical live smoke evidence exists; compatibility with every nominally compatible USB camera is not established.

requirements.feature: Negotiated stream and hardware control verification
requirements.gap: Historical smoke verifies decoded 1080p MJPEG and negotiated 15 fps, not sustained measured sensor throughput. Public doctor does not enumerate focus controls; private focus experiments do not complete a portable verification workflow.

requirements.feature: Private setup-time camera discovery
requirements.gap: Discovery prefers stable index0 paths and uses video0 only as fallback; tests cover preferred discovery and sanitized parsed metadata, not all configured-device error output or alternative hardware discovery.

requirements.feature: Runtime and storage deployment compatibility
requirements.gap: Python 3.13 ARM64 and local detector feasibility have historical reports; guarded storage evidence is private. Broader supported Python/model combinations and a single complete reproducible private deployment compatibility report are not established by these tests.

requirements.feature: On-device NanoDet CPU feasibility experiment
requirements.gap: A measured ARM64 experiment supports the provisional detector selection, not a detector-plus-bird-specific-classifier evaluation. Birder is not selected; species classifier compatibility and performance remain untested.

requirements.feature: Pinned detector artifact and runtime provenance
requirements.gap: NanoDet source revision, weights checksum, licenses, transform, tested ARM64/Python runtime, size, RSS and latency are documented. Generic bird class does not establish local species coverage; classifier candidate inventory and broader compatibility matrix are absent. Isolated runtime evidence is not universal Python support.

requirements.feature: Downscaled MOG2 foreground change detector
requirements.gap: MOG2, blur, shadow exclusion, opening and minimum area are implemented. One synthetic combined test covers trigger persistence/outside-ROI/lighting/reset, not separate assertions for every preprocessing clause or real footage nuisance performance; no bird identity is inferred.

requirements.feature: Normalized validated optional feeder regions
requirements.gap: Rectangle bounds and enabled regions are supported; example regions are disabled placeholders. Private priority ROI is approved, but public tests do not exercise an annotated preview or user-review workflow; no bundled calibrate command exists.

requirements.feature: 640-pixel and 8 Hz motion analysis targets
requirements.gap: 640 width default and hard-coded 1/8-second scheduling target exist. No test measures the defaults/cadence and no sustained hardware analysis rate is established; 8 Hz is a best-effort target, not a measured guarantee.

requirements.feature: Persistent area trigger with region tuning
requirements.gap: Global defaults are 1% and three consecutive frames, but thresholds are not region-specific fields. Synthetic persistence test does not establish 1% boundary behavior or real-footage tuning for each region.

requirements.feature: ROI-only triggers and background reset
requirements.gap: Outside-ROI motion is ignored and detector resets after camera reopen. Focus/exposure changes have no change-detection/reset hooks; automatic major exposure changes do not explicitly reset background. Reconnect reset integration is not directly asserted.

requirements.feature: Broad lighting suppression and decision logging
requirements.gap: Configurable whole-image foreground fraction suppresses broad transients and increments an internal counter. No distinct intensity-change check or suppression decision logging/health publication exists; test asserts suppression outcome, not logs or field effectiveness.

requirements.feature: Best-effort stationary-bird presence scan
requirements.gap: No two-second presence-scan scheduler, capacity admission or skipped-scan reporting exists. Separate analysis of already-saved events cannot recover a stationary bird that never triggered photographs.

requirements.feature: Private fail-closed daylight supervisor
requirements.gap: Approved private scheduling/supervision reportedly validates local solar window, conservative absolute cutoff and launch refusal; public foreground command has only relative duration and no solar guard. Installed/enabled jobs do not prove liveness or reboot behavior; no physical darkness sensor or cumulative 24-hour daylight-only soak evidence.

requirements.feature: Non-root execution and private data permissions
requirements.gap: Private deployment uses existing non-root user and public queue/root permissions are restricted. No bundled dedicated service account, sandbox or least-privilege access audit; file-permission tests do not establish complete deployment account confinement.

requirements.feature: Private single-supervisor runtime boundary
requirements.gap: Private approved Hermes schedules and separate immutable runtimes are reported; application locks only coordinate cooperating owners. Portable systemd installation plus coordinated reboot/rollback and sustained liveness verification remain absent; documentation enables nothing.

requirements.feature: Offline local capture/model with independent private review
requirements.gap: Core inference uses explicitly supplied hash-pinned local weights, without model downloads; separate private supervisor fails closed on invalid solar data. Cross-service failure independence is reported but not fully integration-tested from public checkout; external visual-review and Telegram failure windows remain operational limitations.

requirements.feature: No default listener or bundled upload integration
requirements.gap: No known default listener/upload path in inspected CLI/capture/analyzer. Approved private Telegram/external-review integrations are separate; no comprehensive socket/egress-denial regression test or deployment network audit proves this property under all dependencies/configurations.

requirements.feature: Hardware-independent events/storage with V4L2 adapter
requirements.gap: No known gap in injected-camera replay and separate adapter/library design. Hardware smoke evidence is short-duration only; synthetic tests do not establish physical unplug/replug or every device capability.

requirements.feature: Capture counters and separate shadow summaries
requirements.gap: Capture exposes received/invalid frames, reconnects, dropped saves and storage errors; analysis returns deferred/failed counts. Trigger-suppression and identification-latency counters are absent; sensor frame drops are not measured and queue/model counters are not integrated into capture health.

requirements.feature: Graceful capture shutdown and interrupted-job recovery
requirements.gap: Capture SIGTERM handler, context cleanup, writer draining and startup storage/queue recovery exist. Separate shadow worker does not install the capture SIGTERM cleanup handler; no full process SIGTERM-to-camera/database test, approved reboot test or physical power-loss test establishes the complete contract.

requirements.feature: Tested version snapshots, platform and license notices
requirements.gap: Runtime/dev versions, tested Linux ARM64/Python environment and separate code/weights licenses are documented. Requirements are version snapshots, not a complete hashed reproducible lock: build setuptools is unpinned and package dependency ranges remain broad. Wider platform compatibility and release-time license/packaging reproducibility remain incomplete.

requirements.feature: Private focus-plane verification
requirements.gap: Private reversible focus/framing work exists; exhaustive measured perch distances and focus-plane acceptance are not reproducible from sanitized public documents. No optical-quality inference from overview images.

requirements.feature: Approved priority feeder rather than dual-focus promise
requirements.gap: One priority feeder has private approval; this does not establish acceptable bird-level focus at both possible distances or a keeper-quality release gate.

requirements.feature: Glare and overview-quality limitation
requirements.gap: No implementation promised by this caution. Reflection/glare and bird-level image quality still require private sample review; no general optical-quality guarantee is supported.

requirements.feature: Daylight-only scope and inference limits
requirements.gap: Private supervisor enforces an approved solar window, but core run does not. Enabled schedules are not liveness evidence; night vision, species accuracy and real-time inference remain explicitly unguaranteed.

requirements.feature: Target single-camera Pi hardware
requirements.gap: Target platform is an owner-provided constraint; a live camera/model has been exercised, not every hardware compatibility combination.

requirements.feature: Python motion-triggered photography
requirements.gap: No known implementation gap within this bounded requirement; broader field gates remain separate.

requirements.feature: Candidate prioritization before future species work
requirements.gap: Candidate analysis exists and has false positives; validated species identification is not implemented.

requirements.feature: Near-sunrise start and conservative sunset stop
requirements.gap: Private safeguards and bounded historical sessions exist; public run has no solar guard and full clock/solar/reboot field cases remain open.

requirements.feature: Bounded keeper review and private digest
requirements.gap: Private implementation and regressions exist; this work does not verify a new end-to-end delivered digest.

requirements.feature: Rolling raw expiry without keeper or backup deletion
requirements.gap: Managed-retention and finalizer isolation are tested; sustained hardware media/retention behavior remains a field gate.

requirements.feature: One-camera/no-purchase scope
requirements.gap: Scope decision, not a demand to purchase or implement additional hardware.

requirements.feature: Capture isolated from optional single inference worker
requirements.gap: Public capture has no model call and optional analyzer is separately locked. Historical concurrent capture/analysis evidence exists; comprehensive overloaded/failed-model capture fault injection and sustained resource contention remain unverified. Capture-internal worker orchestration is future, not silently implemented.

requirements.feature: Sanitized hardware observations and private calibration
requirements.gap: Live camera negotiation/focus/storage observations are summarized in sanitized reports and private photos/configuration remain outside Git. Reports are not reproducible calibration data; dynamic deployment properties require fresh checks. Guards/traceability checks are not a full privacy/secret scanner or proof every observation is current.

requirements.feature: Synthetic/replay pytest capture and shadow regression suite
requirements.gap: Capture/shadow suites exercise synthetic/replay frames, fake adapters, temporary storage, timing, retention and schema/recovery. Correction-preservation tests are absent because corrections are not implemented. Private review suites reportedly ran 41 collector + 30 scheduler + 111 finalizer tests, but are not public-reproducible; local pytest is not remote CI, hardware validation or a 24-hour soak.

requirements.feature: Bounded durable SQLite shadow job queue
requirements.gap: Source implements queue_limit=100 with allowed range 1..100, pending/running/completed/failed, three interrupted attempts, completed-manifest discovery, deferred summary counters and bounded scans/storage. Deferred jobs are not persisted as per-event analysis_deferred markers; no explicit reanalysis command or opportunistic-scan priority exists. Changed settings/manifest can create a new job but are not that command; queue is not a complete event index.

requirements.feature: Capture milestone surface
requirements.gap: Core components are implemented; complete physical recovery and sustained reliability gates remain open.

requirements.feature: Approved private keeper workflow versus package boundary
requirements.gap: Private orchestration is not installed by a fresh clone; enabled/prepared states do not prove liveness or delivery.

requirements.feature: Later portable/species/correction release
requirements.gap: Reusable orchestration, species suggestions/corrections, and full recovery evidence are not a completed release.

requirements.feature: Excluded features and no public photo publication
requirements.gap: Negative scope/approval boundary, not an implemented audio/web/multicamera feature or exhaustive security audit.

requirements.feature: Stable requirement identity and compound-status boundaries
requirements.gap: Mapping integrity is automated; semantic coverage, human review, permanent ID governance and private evidence truth are not independently proven by the checker.

requirements.feature: Generated feature/evidence map and reverse indexes
requirements.gap: Mapping integrity is automated; semantic coverage, human review, permanent ID governance and private evidence truth are not independently proven by the checker.

requirements.feature: Explicit review, fingerprints and stale-report checks
requirements.gap: Mapping integrity is automated; semantic coverage, human review, permanent ID governance and private evidence truth are not independently proven by the checker.
